analysis.tier_note: the probes confirm what the Finding says
analysis.reasoning: The paper specifies a Cartesian product over m input TeSA dimensions plus output, yielding |To|∏|Ti| sub-operators. The code asserts exactly one input and one output TeSA and loops only over weight_tesa; wbc_matmuls likewise takes in_tesas[0] and out_tesas[0]. Thus the implementation enumerates only the weight dimension, matching the claimed 1-D deviation.
analysis.would_confirm: A unit test constructing multiple input TeSA options and checking whether all Cartesian-product combinations are specialized would settle it.
